name: periodical
title: Quarterly
character: The site as one issue of a small, well-made magazine: masthead and issue line, numbered sections, drop caps, pull quotes, marginal notes, numbered figures and a colophon, set for long, comfortable reading.
suits: inns and restaurants with a story
notFor: fast transactional pages and shops with large catalogues
night-time venues sold on atmosphere alone
signature: The folio system (issue line, section marks, running numbers carried from masthead to colophon) and marginal notes that sit beside the reading column on wide screens and fold into the text on phones.
